title: A novel deep learning framework with advanced feature engineering for hate speech detection in accented Malayalam speech
core_idea: Develop a comprehensive deep learning framework for detecting hate speech in accented Malayalam speech by extracting rich acoustic features (ZCR, STFT, MFCC, RMS, mel spectrogram) to produce multi-level feature vectors, applying data augmentation (noise injection, time stretching, pitch shifting) and SMOTE-based class balancing, and evaluating multiple classifiers (1D-CNN, SVM, Random Forest, XGBoost, LightGBM) under stratified, hold-out, speaker-independent, cross-dataset, and noise-perturbed validation to assess robustness and generalizability.
tldr: Propose a feature-rich, augmentation- and balance-aware deep learning pipeline to detect hate speech in accented Malayalam speech with multi-level validation and noise-robustness testing.
